description: This is a Java test class for the JacksonSerializationContext, containing unit tests that verify JSON generation, buffer writing, and output stream writing behaviors using the Jackson library.

classes.name: JacksonSerializationContextIT
classes.description: A test class for JacksonSerializationContext, testing JSON generator creation, buffer writing, and stream writing.

methods.name: jsonGeneratorIsCreatedByFactory
methods.description: Test to verify that the JSON generator is created by the custom factory and the creation method is called.

methods.name: createdWithTargetBufferWritesToBuffer
methods.description: Test to verify that when using a target ByteBuffer, data is written to it.

methods.name: createdWithOutputStreamWritersToStream
methods.description: Test to verify that when using an OutputStream, data is written to the stream.

methods.name: writeSomething
methods.description: Helper method to write a simple JSON object and close the generator.
